description: For a scoped formula \(A\) with \(n\) available slots and no free-variable names, terms \(t_0,\ldots,t_{n-1}\) in \(k\) retained slots, and \(b\in M^k\), the simultaneous instance \(A[t_0,\ldots,t_{n-1}]\) is true at \(b\) if and only if \(A\) is true at the tuple of values \(\bigl(\llbracket t_i\rrbracket_b^M\bigr)_{i<n}\).
